capabilities: Encrypt vault files transparently via low-level I/O interception using Argon2id and AES-GCM
Manage master password with envelope encryption (KEK wrapping a DEK) so password changes don't re-encrypt files
Compress encrypted payloads with Deflate and store them in a native binary format
Verify plaintext integrity before and after encryption with MurmurHash3 hashing
Decrypt files outside Obsidian with a separate CLI tool
extras: The README carries strong warnings: early-stage project, not designed for high-stakes data, forgotten passwords mean permanent data loss, and users must manually back up and sync KEK/DEK credentials across devices. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs are in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese; a separate CLI decryption tool is linked.
problem: Obsidian stores all notes as plain text files on disk, so sensitive vault content is readable by anything with file access.
summary: Transparent encryption plugin that encrypts vault files on disk with Argon2id and AES-GCM while you edit normally.
